# OpenColorIO Cube fixture provenance

`LibplaceboLutParserTests.cpp` embeds the unmodified 180-byte contents of
`tests/data/files/iridas_3d.cube` from the Academy Software Foundation's
OpenColorIO repository.

- Repository: https://github.com/AcademySoftwareFoundation/OpenColorIO
- Source commit: `5a808fb57a94c7229640a97835c420c9a1fbd1fe`
- Git blob: `04934465ae6e99416c347897aa5b2cc1a8257432`
- Source path: `tests/data/files/iridas_3d.cube`
- License: BSD-3-Clause; see `LICENSE.txt` in this directory.

This is an interoperability/parser fixture, not a display-calibration profile
or evidence that a particular display has been calibrated.
